full_text: To Lord Linlithgow. DECISION TO FAST. (Whereas Gandhiji in his letters defended the Congress stand Lord Linlithgow, the Viceroy continued to  hold Congress responsible for the August  1Q42  rebellion. A  vigorous anti-Congress, anti-Indian campaign was launched in Foreign countries and a ruthless repression let loose on Indian * rebels Gandhiji was pained at the sight of such a tyrannical policy of the Government. He therefore decided to go on fast and  sent the  following Utter CO the Viceroy.)
